counter_rng.hash: SHA256 exactly; digest first8 bytes interpreted uint64 little-endian; never std::hash, rand, locale encoding or floating-point distribution
counter_rng.reference_validation: exact canonical_kind_registry key and current lookup/generation before RNG; view aliases map by object_ref_wire.view_aliases_to_canonical_kind; skill/thermal are Actor views with no independent identity; local/session/immutable-definition records do not own simulation streams; no natural geography Ref
counter_rng.uniform_bound: integer n from1 through2^63-1; bool/zero/negative/overflow reject
counter_rng.uniform_rule: limit=floor(2^64/n)*n in checked128; attempt starts0; raw=uint64LE(SHA256(preimage)[0:8]); raw>=limit rejects and increments attempt only; otherwise result=raw%n and nextDrawIndex=drawIndex+1. For inclusive[a,b], n=b-a+1 checked and result=a+uniform(n)
counter_rng.attempt_exhaustion: RNG_REJECTION_LIMIT rejects entire candidate; never reseed/change domain/advance eventCounter or silently modulo
counter_rng.counter_advance: per(canonicalSubject,domain) next eventCounter advances once only on successful single-writer publish of immutable EventFreezeReceipt; includes real DecisionEpisode first candidate freeze, conception, actual utterance and due daily recurrence. Mere query, UI preview, render, failed candidate, canceled uncommitted action and worker slice never draw or advance
counter_rng.event_draw_state: frozen EventFreezeReceipt stores algorithmId/domain/eventCounter/definitionHash plus ordered draw purposes and nextDrawIndex; rejected attempts are replayable from preimage, successful draw increments index once; already committed event retry returns saved values and no new draw
counter_rng.overflow: eventCounter/drawIndex advance beyond uint64 rejects RNG_COUNTER_OVERFLOW, no wrap; all domain event shapes have finite definition-bounded draw count
counter_rng.prepare_commit: authorized real event prepares using isolated candidate state; successful publish stores draws/index/counter atomically. UI preview cannot ask random future outcomes or consume a stream. If event froze earlier its committed Receipt is the source, later outcome cancellation does not undo a past freeze

reference_encoding_vector.derived_digest_and_uniform: world_runtime_reference_model.run counter_rng_vectors reports actual calculated digest/raw/uniform10000 during root batch validation; not yet an executed result

reference_rejection_vector.purpose: finite unbiased reduction boundary; injected raw source only in reference verification, never player RNG input
